answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable stake before it can trade, then lock that stake behind a reputation bond that grows only with verified work. A fresh identity starts in the tundra: cold, barren, able to do little until it completes real tasks. An attacker who spawns a thousand clones must fund a thousand stakes and then push each clone through the canyon — a slow, audited climb of completed jobs and peer reviews — before any one reaches the grove where high-value deals happen. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a forest of trusted ones is ruinously expensive.
